Godcrofts, quiet at the previous filing, has produced one further event and still leads every region with seventy-three changes over the past day. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle have gone quiet in the final two-hour reading but remain closely divided, with nine and five events respectively over the last six hours. Farranac Coast shows heavy casualties and sharpened enlistment, although no strongpoint has changed there for more than five hours; Fisherman's Row has brought no change for more than eight. Mooring County also reports elevated fighting without a fresh strategic-base exchange. The campaign still lacks a declared winner.

warden_reinforce.reason: Outwich Ranch is a newly seized Warden base surrounded by Colonial bases in Linn Mercy; reinforcing it is important to avoid an immediate Colonial recapture.

label: GLM 5.3 Flash
headline: Weathered Expanse Swings Back as Dead Lands Flag Reclaimed
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has swung back, five works under Colonial colors against four Warden, after fresh flag action at Frostmarch, that front's busiest post. The fighting there is the day's heaviest: better than 9,600 Colonial and 12,300 Warden casualties in twenty-four hours, the latest hour alone near 750 and 1,150. In the Dead Lands the Warden flag raised at Callahan's Gate has come down, all eleven works standing Colonial once more. The Linn of Mercy has heated anew about Rotdust, Warden losses there climbing sharply, its roll unmoved at one Warden work among eleven. Marban Hollow saw fresh flag work at Mox without change to its eight Colonial works, and Mooring County's toll mounts fast — above a thousand to each side in two hours — though its twelve works stand eleven Warden to one Colonial. Callahan's Passage, second in the day's reckoning though quiet by the flag ledger since the small hours, keeps all ten works under Warden colors. Godcrofts' busy day has stilled, its nine works Colonial throughout; Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf show no flag movement these two hours, their five-to-four splits unmoved. The ledger reads 300 Colonial works to 136 Warden, a net shift of two since our last edition. Day 245; no victor declared.

colonial_reinforce.reason: Crow's Nest has flipped four times today and Warden night assaults (peak ~1156 warden casualties/hr) keep hitting the western Weathered Expanse; garrisoning it firmly converts the recent 20:20-20:33 recapture into a stable line anchor.

colonial_attack.reason: Outwich Ranch has been Warden-held only since the ~20:20 capture from neutral; retaking it quickly before it is fortified exploits Warden overextension, since Wardens are bleeding far faster (270/hr vs 114/hr) in this region.

warden_reinforce.reason: Fort Hoarfrost is the most contested base in the packet with six ownership changes today; Wardens currently hold it, but Colonial pressure (~163 casualties/hr, near-even loss ratio) means it needs hardening to stop the cycle.

warden_attack.reason: Callahan's Gate flipped twice tonight (Warden take at ~17:56, Colonial recapture at ~19:55) and Warden attack tempo in DeadLands is high and rising (~518/hr over 2h, +124/hr change); a renewed northern push can take it permanently.

headline: Weathered Expanse Flares as Gate Struggle Widens
